verdict.rationale: Formant documents secure, low-latency peer-to-peer teleoperation for controlling robots "from anywhere" via joystick, buttons, or custom controls. Teleop interfaces are configurable, commands can be sent during teleoperation, and the Agent SDK exposes teleop methods. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live video streaming in the teleop view (video is only mentioned as time-synced records), detail on behavior over degraded real-world networks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of responsiveness.
